Notes from the seed swap

The seed swap worked because nobody was in charge of it. People brought what they had too much of and took what they lacked. A surplus is only a problem when there is no table to put it on.

I keep noticing that abundance needs a meeting place. The zucchini glut every August is a nuisance in one kitchen and a gift across ten. What turns waste into generosity is not more food but a place where the extra can be seen.

Next year I want a permanent shelf at the garden gate. Leave what you can, take what you need. A small public shelf does more for a neighbourhood than a committee.
